request: Analyze GSE193771 for the paper (Effects of exercise on whole-blood transcriptome profile in children with overweight/obesity): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of a 20-week exercise program vs no-exercise control on whole-blood gene expression in boys with overweight/obesity: group (exercise vs control) x time (pre vs post) interaction, analysed in boys separately (S2.6.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: boys: exercise vs control change from pre to post (group x time interaction); paper: 161 genes at unadjusted P<0.05, 0 at FDR<0.05 (S3.2.p1)
final.paper_method: Quantile normalization, then limma group x time interaction, boys and girls separately (S2.6.2.p1); GEO files are named voomQuantiles, so likely voom with quantile normalization; the OSF scripts were not available
final.sample_inclusion: 24 children with transcriptome data at both time points: boys 5 EX / 8 CON, girls 5 EX / 6 CON (S2.1.p1, TAB1)

paper_results.boys: 161 DEGs (71 up, 90 down), P<0.05; none FDR<0.05
paper_results.girls: 121 DEGs (51 up, 70 down), P<0.05; none FDR<0.05

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.6.2.p1 defines the estimand as the group x time interaction with limma on quantile-normalized data, by sex. S3.2.p1 and FIG1/FIG2 give the DEG counts at unadjusted P<0.05 and state no gene passes FDR<0.05. S2.1.p1 and TAB1 give the sample sizes.

checks: metadata: 48 whole-blood samples of 24 children (26 male / 22 female), exercise / no exercise, t0 / t1, matching 13 boys (5/8) and 11 girls (5/6)
the boys voomQuantiles file holds exactly the 13 children (exercise 5 / control 8), 26 samples matching the metadata titles

ownership.reasoning: Accession named in the paper; sample counts and group sizes match TAB1.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal the title after 'sample: ' (exact match on the derived key). Subject = title stem before the trailing _1/_2 time suffix (C74_1 and C74_2, E88_1 and E88_2 are distinct children, consistent with 13 boys / 11 girls). grp from the GEO group field, time from the time-point field (t0 = pre, t1 = post). Only the boys samples are in this matrix; the other sex's metadata rows stay unmatched by design.

final.source: GSE193771_voomQuantiles_boys.txt.gz (author-deposited normalized matrix), summary columns removed by prep script

matrix.reasoning: Non-integer values from about -1.5 to 14.4 with median about 4.5, the range of voom log2-CPM; file name voomQuantiles and S2.6.2.p1 (quantile normalization before limma). Already filtered to expressed genes (3929 boys / 3715 girls). The raw-count files are the alternative input; rejected because the deposited normalized matrix is the paper's own limma input.

candidates.reason_rejected: not the paper's normalized input; the case runner has no voom+quantile interaction executor

design.subject: subject

contrasts.name: grp_time_EX_t1_vs_CON_t0
contrasts.estimand: difference in pre-to-post change, exercise minus control (group x time interaction)

design.reasoning: S2.6.2.p1: group x time interaction, sexes separately. Each child has a pre and a post sample, so the interaction is estimated as the difference between arms in within-child change (paired_change), which blocks on child. Group is constant within child, so subject + grp cannot sit in one fixed model. Randomized trial (S2.1.p2), so the estimand is causal.

candidates.reason_rejected: ignores baseline; paper analyses the interaction

candidates.value: pooled boys + girls with sex covariate
candidates.reason_rejected: paper analyses sexes separately and the deposited normalized matrices are per sex

covariance.reasoning: Pre and post samples come from the same child; blocking by child via within-child differences. No batch or covariate is described for the transcriptome model in the paper; sex is handled by stratification (separate case).

final.method: limma (paired_change: lmFit + eBayes on within-subject t1 - t0 differences of the voom-quantile log2 matrix)

paper_route.method: limma-voom (quantile) with group x time interaction on raw counts, voom precision weights
paper_route.reason: the case runner's limma-voom executor is two-arm only and the paper's script (OSF) is not available; voom weights are not in the deposited matrix

deviations: no voom precision weights (deposited log2 values used unweighted)
pairing handled by within-child differences; whether the paper blocked on child is not stated

method.reasoning: The matrix is the paper's normalized log2 input, so limma applies directly. The paper model's subject handling is not stated; paired_change is the within-subject estimate of the interaction. Sensitivity run: unpaired ~ grp*time limma interaction on the same matrix.

threshold.reasoning: S3.2.p1, FIG1/FIG2: DEG counts use unadjusted P<0.05 with no fold-change rule; the paper also reports FDR<0.05 (none pass), recorded as the audit rule.

caveats: the paper's DEG lists at raw P<0.05 are near the number expected by chance on ~3.9k genes (about 5%); none pass FDR
no voom weights; the paper's pairing handling is unknown
enrichment here is MSigDB Hallmark GSEA, not the paper's topKEGG on the DEG list

study.reasoning: Same matrix, estimand and threshold as the paper; the declared deviations are the missing voom weights and the explicit within-child pairing.
